## Interface as built

**`gov doctor`** — read command, exit 0 on healthy, exit 3 on any failure/drift.
- 11 sections: tools, hooks, path_map, path_compliance, index_freshness, canaries, framework_lock, isolation, adoption_level, claude_code, held_out
- Error in measurement → status "fail" (not "unmeasured")
- Component absent → status "unmeasured" (not failure, not unhealthy)
- Adoption level capped at INTERMEDIATE when any section is unmeasured
- `healthy: true` only when no section is "fail" or "drift"

**`gov rebuild`** — act command, exit 0 on success.
- Calls `gov.retrieval.lexical.refresh(root)` to recreate lexical index (with preseed optimization)
- Tries `gov.retrieval.semantic.refresh(root)` with measured error capture
- Reports `"stores"` dict with per-store status (recreated/not_recreated with reason)
- No hardcoded DDL — lexical index creation delegated to the module that owns it

**`recovery-rebuild` check** — registered under `template/governance/kernel/checks/recovery-rebuild.yaml`, family `checkpoint-and-recovery`, compares rebuild digests.

**Path-map schema** — `src/gov/config/` validates against W1-08 schema (DEC-228). Backward compatible with partial W1-08 keys.
